instruction: A cinematic medium shot of a sunny outdoor park with green grass and leafy trees. On the left, the woman with the afro (R6) in a red t-shirt and jeans pulls a playful, wide-eyed expression. In the center, the East Asian man (R3) in a red polo shirt and a red bandana laughs heartily with his hands raised in a gesture. On the right, the woman in the black beanie (R5) in a red t-shirt smiles. The woman with the afro and the woman in the beanie keep their arms draped over the shoulders of the central East Asian man as he laughs. Bright, natural daylight illuminates the scene.
